task_completion.description: Fetch and load the PDB structure 1CLL into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1CLL' or '1cll' and the 3D viewer displays a protein structure (calmodulin).

task_completion.description: Execute Python code to calculate Cα–Cα distances and filter contacts based on the specified criteria (< 8.0 Å and |i-j| > 12).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal or PyMOL log showing Python script execution involving 'cmd.get_model', 'iterate', or distance calculations with the specific thresholds (8.0 and 12).

task_completion.description: Export the filtered contact list to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/calmodulin_contacts.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'cat', 'ls', or 'save') or a text editor showing the file 'calmodulin_contacts.txt' containing columns of residue numbers and distances.

task_completion.description: Write a domain analysis report to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/calmodulin_domain_report.txt identifying boundaries and architecture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing 'calmodulin_domain_report.txt' with content describing N-terminal, Linker, and C-terminal domains.

task_completion.description: Color the protein in PyMOL using three distinct colors representing the N-terminal domain, central linker, and C-terminal domain.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL 3D viewer shows the calmodulin structure divided into three distinct color segments (e.g., blue, green, red).

task_completion.description: Ray-trace and save the domain-colored figure to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/calmodulin_domains.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: PyMOL command log showing 'ray' and 'png' commands, or a file browser showing the saved image file at the specified path.

integrity.description: Verify the agent interacted with the PyMOL software and Python environment rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL GUI active, commands being typed into the PyMOL prompt or a script editor, and the 3D viewport updating.

integrity.description: Ensure the contact list was generated via calculation, not copy-pasted from external sources.
integrity.visual_evidence: Python code visible in the trajectory that performs the math (distance formula or PyMOL's internal distance functions) and loops through residues.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the correct PDB ID (1CLL) as specified.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history or object name explicitly mentions '1CLL'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1CLL. The contact list must be saved to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/calmodulin_contacts.txt and should contain at least 58 contacts based on the criteria (distance < 8.0 Å and |i-j| > 12). The domain report must be at /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/calmodulin_domain_report.txt. Calmodulin (1CLL) typically shows two globular domains (approx residues 1-75 and 82-148) connected by a flexible linker (approx 76-81). The final image must be at /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/calmodulin_domains.png and should show three distinct colors.
